title: MITRE ATT&CK T1110 - Brute Force
summary: Brute force involves systematic or repeated attempts to discover credentials. Multiple correlated authentication failures may justify investigating brute force. A single failed authentication operation does not establish brute force or compromise.

title: MITRE ATT&CK T1078 - Valid Accounts
summary: Adversaries can abuse valid account credentials to access systems or increase privileges. A failed attempt to switch users or authenticate to root does not by itself demonstrate stolen credentials, successful access, or privilege escalation.

title: NIST SP 800-61 Rev. 3 - Incident Response
summary: Incident response includes preparing for, detecting, responding to, and recovering from incidents. Analysts should examine available evidence and operational context before deciding whether security activity requires incident response. Investigation conclusions should distinguish observed events from assumptions.

title: MITRE DET0463 - Brute Force Authentication Detection
summary: Brute-force detection can correlate numerous authentication failures, patterns over time, and failures followed by successful access. Two Wazuh alerts generated by the same failed authentication operation must not automatically be counted as two independent login attempts.
